from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0 or any((b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]) != (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-20f93ffb.py'
file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(file), 'exec'), globals())
demo_in=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo_in[r][c]=1
demo_expected=[row[:] for row in demo_in]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: demo_expected[r][c]=2
print(transform(demo_in)==demo_expected)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
result=transform(test)
print([(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(result) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v])
print(result)
